decision_owner: Stage D explicit structural-source admission decision

prerequisites.evidence: Official QAC download and 0.4 release-notes pages.

prerequisites.requirement: Exact candidate byte identity, real format, counts, field disposition, and reproducible independent hash check
prerequisites.evidence: Stage-A manifest plus local bytes and immutable public-mirror byte match.

prerequisites.requirement: Direct official acquisition/byte-chain evidence for the candidate artifact
prerequisites.blocker: A read-only GET of the official endpoint exposed only a contact-email POST form and no direct artifact link or checksum. No owner contact email was supplied, so official response bytes were not obtained.

prerequisites.requirement: Unambiguous license and redistribution/modification conditions for the combined QAC/Tanzil file
prerequisites.blocker: Official GPLv3, QAC no-change/attribution terms, FAQ non-commercial/research/citation language, the embedded historical Tanzil CC BY-ND 3.0 notice, and Tanzil's current CC BY 3.0/no-change page are not authoritatively reconciled.

prerequisites.requirement: Accepted separate structural-source and token/segment persistence design, migrations, constraints, and contracts
prerequisites.blocker: Stage B was not authorized or implemented.

prerequisites.requirement: Real-artifact parser/importer with deterministic, idempotent, fail-closed validation
prerequisites.blocker: Stage C was not authorized or implemented; the current parser is fixture-only.

prerequisites.requirement: Complete active-Tanzil reconciliation and negative-path evidence for every segment
prerequisites.blocker: Stage A established identity compatibility and mismatch requirements only, not production alignment.

prerequisites.requirement: Prohibited semantic-field quarantine/rejection and immutable provenance-binding evidence
prerequisites.blocker: Requires the future real importer and persistence boundary.

stage_d_rule: Only after every mandatory prerequisite exists may Stage D explicitly decide APPROVED or NOT_APPROVED; no earlier evidence pre-answers that decision.
